btc_benchmark_calculation.step_1_filter: Include discrete spot CLOBs only; exclude derivatives and internalized retail broker quotes

btc_depth_aggregation_and_hhi.interpretation: Moderately concentrated liquidity (1500 < HHI < 2500). No single exchange commands a monopoly on order-book depth.

cme_futures_basis_annualization.operational_realizability_caveat: 13.2% is an annualized gross price dislocation. Realized carry requires accounting for SOFR funding on spot capital, FCM margin requirements on CME Clearing, execution fees, and lack of cross-margining.

disaggregated_opportunity_score.deduction_rationale: Score reduced from 100 to 53 to penalize operational friction, financing drag, and disjoint exchange-to-clearinghouse custody.

non_execution_proof.engine_interface: No execute, sign, trade, or transfer methods exist on SovereignMarketIntelligenceEngine or UnifiedMarketDiscoveryEngine.
non_execution_proof.runtime_invariant: 100% of opportunity objects and feed payloads enforce execution_authorized: false.
non_execution_proof.endpoint_probe: GET /api/market/intelligence/* endpoints are read-only and return no private key or signing oracle hooks.
